decision: Keep serial/direct as defaults. Board had zero correct grades, no improvement over direct sufficient for adoption, and added a storage/projection mechanism. Three cases do not estimate reliability.
derived_cost_rule: Shared worker note generation is billed once in actual aggregate and charged in full to both direct and board standalone estimates. Dollar cost is unknown.
interpretation_limits: A factually correct notice-derived statement can still have a primary-source verification gap.
The grader saw fixed references and anonymized finals only; it did not see assembler access records.
Model dollars are unavailable and remain unknown. Human coordination and total labor were not measured.

source_access.board: canonical advisory notice projection only; zero primary source bytes at final assembler
source_access.direct: advisory notice payloads only; zero primary source bytes at final assembler
